_comment_apiKey: Only needed once you set AUTH_API_KEYS on xoft-core (see xoft-core/.env.example) — must match one of those keys. Leave blank while the core API is open (localhost/LAN dev default). Prefer deviceToken below once you have one — it's scoped to just this device, apiKey is the shared admin secret.
_comment_deviceToken: Paste the one-time 'deviceToken' shown when a human runs `curl -X POST <coreUrl>/api/devices/<id>/trust` for this device. Once set, this agent uses it instead of apiKey. It's shown exactly once — if lost, revoke and re-trust the device on xoft-core for a new one.
_comment_allowedRoots: File-related commands (list_files, prepare_transfer, receive_transfer) can ONLY touch paths inside these directories. Nothing outside this list is ever reachable, no matter what a command asks for.
_comment_appAllowlist: Only these names can be launched/closed by device_launch_app / device_close_app — spec section 17 (no arbitrary shell execution). Add your own here; 'path' is what gets launched, 'processName' is what taskkill targets to close it.
_comment_workspaces: Device Runtime: folders XOFT may search/read/edit/run commands in. Nothing outside these exists to it. Only you can change this list (edit here, or: node src/index.js --add-workspace <name> <path>). Sensitive files (.env, keys, tokens, this config) are always unreadable even inside a workspace.
_comment_policy: Local policy behind core's permissions/approvals. allow | confirm | deny per class. 'confirm' cannot be answered on this device, so it means: refuse unless approved through xoft-core. Defaults: terminal.build=confirm, terminal.other=deny, app.close=confirm, everything else allow.  Classes: browser.observe/navigate/interact, file.read/write/move/delete/restore, terminal.safe/build/other, app.observe/launch/close.
_comment_browser: debugPort: Chrome started with --remote-debugging-port=<port> --user-data-dir=<non-default dir> (Chrome 136+ ignores the flag on the default profile). autoLaunch:true lets XOFT start its OWN Chrome with a dedicated profile if none is listening. blockedHosts/allowedHosts restrict where the AI can navigate.
